Temporary
Executive rct
Schedule B, Subdivision IV, of the civil service rules, of positions subject
to noncompetitive examination, is hereby amended by the addition of a new
section to read as follows:
,5. Not to exceed twenty clerical positions in the Military Intelligence
Branch, Executive Division, General Staff, during the continuance of the
war only, for highly confidential service. O D O W W L O
TiiF, WVITn HOUSE,
4 April, 1918.
[No. 2833.]
)
Bp
